'''Ember's Fire''' was a club owned by [[Ember Chankeli]], offering female companionship to paying customers, which operated on [[Telerath/Legends|Telerath]]. Chankeli claimed that her business was suffering from a [[Musori's gang|enslaver gang]] operating in the city to hire former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Dass Jennir]] to clean them out. He later stayed in the place when he arrived on Telerath.<ref name="Blue Harvest 2" />

[[Tam (Telerath)|Tam]] and [[Sylva]] were two employees at Ember's Fire.<ref name="Blue Harvest 2" />
